response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT r.name AS raceName, ds.points AS pts FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 AND r.name IS NOT NULL), per_race AS (SELECT raceName, AVG(pts) AS avgPts FROM kept GROUP BY raceName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avgPts) AS overallAvg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceName AS raceName, p.avgPts AS avgPoints, p.avgPts - o.overallAvg AS differenceFromOverall FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avgPts > o.overallAvg;
